units.title: Principle & elements of Design
uos: 1.a. Understand principle of design.
1.b. Understand elements of design.
1.c. Select appropriate principle of design to make a drawing
1.d. Select appropriate element of design to create a drawing

units.title: Properties of different drawing tools & sketching and painting media
topics: 2.1. Experiment & use of different type of pencils
2.2. Experiment & use of different type of pen( Sketch Pen, Crayons, Etc)

units.title: Shades & Texture creation with different tools
topics: 3.1. Different types of hatching Technique (a) Dot hatching (b) Cone hatching (c) Cross hatching
3.2. Uses of continuous tones , cross contour and stippling technique for shading
3.3. Experiment with different tools and techniques to create different values
3.4. Different tones made with different values or texture
uos: 3.a. Understand different shading technique
3.b. Create the illusion of volume, depth, and the natural way light describes form
3.c. Apply use of point & line to create various shading effect
3.d. Create different texture & tones by using crayon, and Water color wash.

units.title: Discovering Forms & their function to create design
topics: 4.1. Study of Basic forms and functions as found in nature and environment
4.2. Create Still life basic shapes using different form

4.5. Study and practice of various Traditional, Creative, abstract forms
uos: 4.a. Understand Different Forms & functions
4.b. Create different 2D and 3D design Forms.
4.c. Describe different drawing & painting technique using different type of form.
4.d. Physical properties of textile fibres
4.e. Chemical properties of textile fibres
